songs.title: Angel in Disguise
songs.lyrics:
Angel in Disguise / Tattooed Back --- [Daniel Lee Original]
In the halls of healing and the beds of pain,
there's girl with golden hair
With wings inked on her back
Walking by – tried not to stare

she hides her grace, in the human race.
To steal a moment's peace in

(Chorus)
She's an angel in disguise, with weary eyes,
She walks among us under mortal skies.
With a cigarette in hand, she finds reprieve,
From the souls she greets, and the ones she grieves.

She's the keeper of the threshold, the guide to the light,
Welcoming the weary travelers into the night.
But even angels need to rest, to sigh and to yearn,
For a moment of silence, for the tide to turn.

(Chorus)
She's an angel in disguise, with weary eyes,
She walks among us under mortal skies.
With a cigarette in hand, she finds reprieve,
From the souls she greets, and the ones she grieves.

In the guise of a girl, so fair and so bright,
She takes her break at the edge of twilight.
A puff of smoke to ease the load she bears,
A fleeting solace from her endless cares.

(Bridge)
And when the dawn comes, she'll spread her wings,
To carry on with the divine things.
she's just a girl, so it seems,
Taking a break from the eternal dreams.

(Chorus)
She's an angel in disguise, with weary eyes,
She walks among us under mortal skies.
With a cigarette in hand, she finds reprieve,
From the souls she greets, and the ones she grieves.

(Outro)
here's to the angel with the tattooed back,
Finding comfort in the things the heavens lack.
She finds her peace, her moment so dear,
In the smoke-filled pause of her celestial career.
